source_assessment.record_and_writer_contract: CityState is nine raw words in the existing placement Record.fixed variant, not a second pose/model/roster store. Creation initializes position and the valid inverted box before insertion; insertion states the complete record after placement/link declaration. The existing same-sector fixed-position setter re-states it, a cross-sector setter writes before re-insertion, and the one new ct_msgs call states it only after the last box expansion and assertions. No query-time state adoption or fallback was added.
source_assessment.lifecycle: The existing record persists across a CITY sector relink while children keep it alive; LINK precedes re-statement at the new key. Empty removal ends that record; fresh insertion has no state until stated. Withdrawal leaves placement, child list and object identity intact; a subsequent valid lifecycle statement restores the property. The new enum variant is handled by existing state merging and family separation. Same-sector and relink behavior, withdrawal/re-statement, empty/with-children and reset have focused controls. These are source/controlled proofs, not observed retail lifetime coverage.
source_assessment.writer_census_limits: ct_creat.c supplies the initial sentinel and attributes; ct_vec3d.c registers box getters only; the CITY pack/unpack hooks are empty; the actual box expansion is ct_msgs.c. Generic fixed setters remain active and are included rather than dismissed by entity-name inference. Text guards support this current-source census, not a universal proof that future aliases or new writers are impossible.

No fixed-family or Movers state is silently substituted.

diagnostic_assessment.strict_CURRENT_join: Only a well-formed question whose key equals the entry actually served, at the reached CITY position/box stage and over a report the real provider acknowledged, credits city_state_joined or withdraws state. Wrong served key is a request fault and is not credited/mutated even when the provider can answer the other live key.
diagnostic_assessment.real_property_withdrawal: After a successful eligible real lookup and before returning that SAME reply unchanged, the host sends the same provider ONE real withdrawal of only the record state and requires removed. Placement, child list, Core entity and object identity are not removed; no fabricated answer, Core write or double delegation is used.
diagnostic_assessment.continuation: Unlike NeedPlacement, a CITY-stage answer does not guarantee a same-city continuation. The control waits for the NEXT actual question of that key that reaches the CITY state stage, then requires the real provider refusal: entity_candidate.refused plus candidate.city/withdrew, request0/reply1 and the anchored first-fault class. Questions of buildings or the CITY early stage do not satisfy it.
diagnostic_assessment.UNREACHED_and_failures: A clean lack of an eligible lookup or a clean lack of the second same-CITY-stage question is UNREACHED, not success. Request/reply faults and unrelated fatal markers before eligibility remain failures. A later valid question may be observed under the existing whole-trace policy, but nonzero request faults still prevent a passing refusal. The whole poisoned branch uses retained observations, with physical counters unknown rather than new engine queries.
diagnostic_assessment.actual_gate: Root must first obtain one healthy current run with boot-or-armed CITY report evidence, current joined CITY-stage consumption and no faults. Its armed report count may legitimately be zero. The negative requires a reached second same-CITY-stage question and real named refusal; if absent, retain UNREACHED with no actor/time/geometry hunting or criterion relaxation.
diagnostic_assessment.coverage_limits: C controls exercise actual shared placement-map/adapter headers with scripted entities.
